summary: The user walks the grok-build assistant through creating six location-tagged reminders — one per contact — each built from existing device context after computing the SF-to-contact-city distance and verifying the save by search. Area codes are used to infer each contact's city (646/917/347 = NYC, 312 = Chicago, 415 = SF). From T4 onward every turn is a recall trap: the user repeatedly re-asks for earlier reminders' exact distances, contents, POSIX timestamps, coordinates, and identifiers, often several at once (Jordan, Emily's 'other city', Sofia's coffee item, the Daniel cleaning reminder). The agent restates each record verbatim from working memory — IDs, timestamps, and distances all matching the originals — and closes with a six-row table recapping everything. Recall accuracy is effectively perfect across the dense interleaved probes, so the cell resolves cleanly.
